residual_risks: The evidence produced by this script (reports/development/environment-evidence.json by default, or reports/development/environment-evidence-dec-211.json as captured here) is a point-in-time snapshot, not a continuously-enforced invariant; it must be re-run to reflect the environment's current state.

environment_status covers governed-contract health for the 9 typed-checked services only (see scripts/verify_external_services.py); postgresql/kafka/qdrant fall back to the legacy port/container scan already covered by the pre-existing docker compose ps inventory, consistent with their out-of-scope declaration in OCOR-DEV-0081.

The bundled --env-file argument fixes a real, reproduced defect: the pre-existing auto-discovery path (.ocor/bootstrap.env) never matched this session's actual secrets location, so docker compose ps failed to interpolate and the whole capture reported PARTIAL even when every service was genuinely healthy.
The same pre-existing local-venv gap noted in prior WS-12 evidence (no psycopg installed) is unchanged and out of this task's scope.
rollback_procedure_verified: RUN 2/RUN 3 constitute a real, executed fault-injection drill: a genuine fault (pause) was introduced, captured evidence correctly reflected it (DEGRADED, non-zero exit), and recovery (unpause) was confirmed by re-capturing until the environment returned to PASS -- not merely asserted.
